text: You open your eyes. And you're in the middle ages. And no, don't get excited. You're not a noble.
Do you really think you would be royalty if we teleported you back in time?
Of course you're a peasant. Your house is just one single room. That's it. One.
And that one room has to be a bedroom, kitchen, living room, storage, and emergency farm.
Because the animals sleep inside with you to keep warm. Chickens, goats, maybe a pig.
The floor is dirt. Literally dirt. Every time someone walks, dust floats in the air. You breathe it all day.
There's no glass in the windows, just uneven wooden shutters that kinda close if you kick them hard
